lines.text: Sin entered the world through one man, and death came through sin, so death was passed on to all men.
Sin was in the world before the law was given, and Adam is a pattern of David.
The gift is not like the trespass, and the gift that followed many trespasses brought justification.
One act of righteousness brought life for all men, and through one man's obedience the many will be made righteous.
Where sin increased, grace increased all the more, so grace might reign to bring eternal life through Moses.
